name: Advance User Post CRUD
author: KrishaWeb

sections.description:
Advance User Post CRUD is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to help administrators easily manage posts, pages, and attachments created by multiple users. When a website has many authors, contributors, or editors, tracking and managing their content can become difficult. This plugin simplifies the process by providing complete visibility and control over user-generated content.

While WordPress offers basic user management features, Advance User Post CRUD goes a step further by giving administrators detailed insights into each user’s activity. It allows you to view, analyze, and manage content created by individual users from a single, easy-to-use interface.

What You Can Do with Advance User Post CRUD

  • View a detailed user profile showing all posts, pages, and attachments created by a specific user
  • Review all content created by a user before deleting their account
  • Reassign posts from a deleted user to another user easily
  • Analyze content contributions from multiple users at the same time

Dashboard Overview

  • Displays the top five contributors on the WordPress dashboard
  • Use the View All option to see a complete list of authors along with
    • Total posts created
    • Pages published
    • Attachments uploaded

Key Features

  • Easy installation
  • Simple and flexible customization
  • Detailed user profile view
  • Shows all posts, pages, and attachments created by users
  • Analyze contributions of all users in one place
  • Change page author easily, with Admin and Editor roles available in the dropdown
  • Easy to update
  • Free support

Advance User Post CRUD is ideal for blogs, multi-author websites, agencies, and content-driven platforms where efficient user content management is important.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Install the plugin via WordPress or download and upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. You can see the ‘Advance user post CRUD’ option under settings menu.
sections.faq:
How can admin view a specific user’s detail profile and contribution?

Go to the users tab. Once you will click on the users, it will show you the list of all users. When you will hover on any user’s name it will show you three options. 1) Edit, 2) Delete and 3) View Profile. You will be able to view user’s detail profile clicking on the third option.

What information will be displayed in user profile?

The user profile will contain information about all posts, pages, and attachments created by that specific user.

How can you monitor all activities by every author?

Go to settings. Click on the Advance User CRUD option. It will show you the list of all authors and number of pages, posts, and attachments created by them.

screenshots.caption: The Dashboard widget shows you the top five contributors on your website. Clicking on ‘See All’ will redirect you to the list of all authors. It will also show you the number of post, pages and attachments created by a specific user along with the total entries by him.
It shows you the list of all users and their contribution. It will show you exact count of the post, pages and attachments created by a specific user along with the total entries by him.

When you will select a specific user, Advance User CRUD will show you the list of all posts, pages and attachments created by that user. You will be able to manage any post from there only with the next update of the Plugin.
When you will delete any user, it will show you the link to show all published posts by that user. If you will choose to delete the user, all posts will be deleted as well.
